reason: COMPLEX. The first thing I noticed was the sachet: I sleep at my partner's a few nights a week, and one tear-open pack in my bag beats carrying a bottle around. The 3 forms are close to what I already take, and the QR batch report is a nice extra, so I'd try one box.
objection: It costs about double what I pay for my 12-in-1 in a flash sale, and I still don't know if I'd feel any difference in sleep or cramps.
would_change_my_mind: A smaller trial pack or a first-box discount around $20, so I can see whether I feel a difference before I pay full price.
